create_SDPOConfig: create an SDPOConfig instance to configure Self-Distillation Policy Optimization with custom loss and teacher parameters
configure_SDPO_teacher: configure SDPOConfig with EMA teacher regularization and a custom update rate for online teacher construction
set_SDPO_loss_mode: set SDPOConfig to hybrid loss mode combining online policy loss and self-distillation loss
customize_SDPO_reprompting: customize SDPOConfig reprompt templates, solution templates, and environment feedback settings
validate_SDPOConfig: validate SDPOConfig by instantiating it with constrained parameters that trigger __post_init__ validation checks
